summary.zh-CN: SltBox 2026102701：重做 184 种动物图鉴与生态条件，采摘和获取动物先播放动画，修复跨天及响应丢失时的树能量同步，并改进树木卡包与装饰。
summary.en-US: SltBox 2026102701 rebuilds the 184-species wildlife catalog and ecology, plays harvest and capture animations before requests, fixes tree energy sync across days and lost responses, and improves tree card packs and decorations.
